snippet.title: Hazmat Simulator // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/5236060/Hazmat_Simulator

Command drones, deploy mobile air defense systems and conduct tactical aerial operations. Choose your side - Ukrainian or Russian forces - and protect critical infrastructure in a realistic military simulation on a detailed map.

👥 Players: Single Player, Online Co-op
🛠️ Developer: BM Studio
📚 Publisher: BM Studio
📅 Release Date: Oct 9, 2026
🎯 Genre: Adventure, Indie, Simulation
